headline: Harper's single off Hader walks off the Astros
recap: With the automatic extra-innings runner Kyle Schwarber standing on second to start the bottom of the 10th, Trea Turner drew a leadoff walk off Josh Hader and Bryce Harper followed with a single to right field that scored Schwarber and gave the Phillies a 3-2 win over the Astros. No one was out when the winning run crossed.

Houston had taken a 2-0 lead in the top of the fourth on Shay Whitcomb's two-run double off Zack Wheeler, who worked six innings and struck out six. Brandon Marsh's solo home run in the fifth, his 13th of the year, cut the deficit to 2-1, and the Phillies tied it in the sixth on a Bryce Harper double and a Nick Castellanos RBI single.

Both bullpens held after that. Orion Kerkering, Jeff Hoffman and Carlos Estevez combined for three scoreless innings for Philadelphia before Matt Strahm worked a scoreless top of the 10th to pick up the win. Hader, pitching the bottom half, took the loss.
